name: Reactive VCR

params.help: Track that drives the effect; empty = the source video's audio
params.label: Audio

steps.name: render
steps.script:
audio=${VB_P_AUDIO:-$VB_SOURCE_AUDIO}
if [ -z "$audio" ]; then
  echo "reactive-vcr: the source has no audio track; choose an Audio file" >&2
  exit 1
fi
reactive-vcr --audio "$audio" --map "$VB_P_MAP" --audio-mode none -o "$VB_OUT" "$VB_IN"

summary: Audio-reactive VCR artifacts (pipelines/reactive-vcr). Driven by the source video's own audio unless an audio file is chosen.
